Hi Alex / AtlasEdge team,

Thanks again for the great conversation at WestNet last week. Per our chat, wed like to propose two near-term options for an in-person design review and adjacent executive dinner so we can align on integration, security needs, and rollout timelines:

- Option A: Executive dinner + brief intro session — Tuesday, May 26 evening (7:00pm)
- Option B: On-site technical deep-dive at AtlasEdge HQ — Monday, May 31 (09:00:30)

Attached is a draft agenda (AtlasEdge_Onsite_Agenda_v2.pdf). Wed like to confirm:
- Who from security/procurement should we loop in for access and vendor checks?
- Any required paperwork (vendor security questionnaire / network form) we should complete beforehand?
- SE support: Dev Patel is copied — Dev, can you confirm availability for a half-day workshop on 5/31 and list any room / hardware needs?

If those dates don't work, share two alternatives that week. We can be flexible on timing.

Next steps: once we lock dates, Marcus (ccd) will also review for any SLA/contract questions. Monica (ccd) from CS will coordinate logistics.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Priya / Alex,

For security intake we typically need the following ahead of any on-site demo with live data or network access:

1) SOC 2 Type II summary or equivalent (high-level is fine to start)
2) Completed vendor security questionnaire (I will attach our standard form)
3) Point of contact for network access requests and expected IP ranges
4) Any demo materials that touch PII (how its handled)

If you can provide the SOC2 summary and the contact who will fill the vendor form, well triage internally. Procurement will coordinate contract and PO.

Thanks,
Kara Mendez
Security Lead, AtlasEdge
kara.mendez@atlasedge.com
